oa.demo.ann_title_1: Notice on the 2026 National Day Holiday Arrangement
oa.demo.ann_content_1:
In accordance with the notice of the General Office of the State Council and based on the company's actual situation, the 2026 National Day holiday arrangement is announced as follows:

I. Holiday: October 1 (Thursday) to October 7 (Wednesday), a total of 7 days off.

II. Work on October 10 (Saturday).

III. All departments should make work arrangements in advance to ensure normal operations during the holiday.

IV. Please stay safe during the holiday. Happy holidays to everyone!
oa.demo.ann_title_2: Company Information Security Management Policy (2026 Edition)
oa.demo.ann_content_2:
Chapter 1 General Provisions

Article 1 This policy is formulated to strengthen the company's information security management and protect its information systems and data security, in accordance with relevant national laws and regulations and the company's actual situation.

Article 2 This policy applies to all employees and external partners of the company.

Chapter 2 Account Management

Article 3 System accounts are uniformly assigned by the IT department after an employee joins the company.

Article 4 Account passwords must meet complexity requirements and be changed regularly.
oa.demo.ann_content_3:
To enrich employees' spare time and strengthen team cohesion, the company will organize an autumn team building event on October 18, 2026 (Sunday).

Venue: XX Ecological Park
Activities: Outdoor training, BBQ, team games
Registration: Now until October 10
How to register: Please contact your department's admin staff

Everyone is welcome to join!
oa.demo.ann_title_4: Draft Attendance Policy Revision for Comments
oa.demo.ann_content_4: To further standardize the company's attendance management and improve efficiency, the Human Resources Dept plans to optimize the current attendance policy. The draft is now released for comments. Please have all departments organize discussions and send feedback to Human Resources before October 15.
oa.demo.ann_title_5: Announcement on Launching the New OA System
oa.demo.ann_content_5:
To improve office efficiency, the company will officially launch the new OA system on October 1, 2026. The old system will be shut down at 24:00 on September 30.

New system address: https://oa.topems.com
Login account: Employee number
Initial password: Last six digits of ID card

Please log in promptly and change your password. Contact IT support if you have any issues.
